remarks: MINT CONDITION - MOVE-IN READY! Tastefully updated garden style condo at Beachcomber. Freshly paint throughout in neutral tones, newly refinished gleaming hardwood floors. AGENTS PLEASE READ AGENT REMARKS REGARDING APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS! Listing agent is a co-owner.
